<para id="fs-id1904415">No, there are many ways to connect resistors that are not combinations of series and parallel, including loops and junctions. In such cases Kirchhoff’s rules, to be introduced in <link document="m42359">Kirchhoff’s Rules</link>, will allow you to analyze the circuit.
</para>
after:
<para id="fs-id1904415">No. Not every resistor network can be reduced to series and parallel combinations. These more general networks can be analyzed using Kirchhoff’s rules, which are beyond the scope of this textbook.
</para>
